title: UDF faces criticism over Ministers’ alleged foreign junkets, Keralam CM’s private plane travel
summary: CPI(M) leader P. Rajeeve alleges that UDF Ministers have signalled to the electorate that ordinary citizens without resources are at a disadvantage compared with the moneyed elite, who dole out freebies and fund foreign jaunts for ‘power centres and authority figures’

title: More ragi with less water: Online programme to promote ‘Guli Ragi’ cultivation on September 23
summary: Farmers in parts of Haveri district have been harvesting around 20 quintals per acre by adopting ‘Guli Ragi’ method, as compared to 15 quintals by the traditional method

title: Another inscription brought to light at Kondaveedu fort
summary: The record on the right-hand doorway pillar of the ruined Siva temple on Rudrapada Sikharam grants four ‘putlu’ of wetland to gurus associated with Tapanacharyulu, the ASI’s epigraphy chief says

title: IIT Bombay to replace ceiling fans with wall-mounted fans after student’s death
summary: The image of a batch of wall-mounted fans arriving at the campus as part of ‘renovation work’ has gone viral on social media.

title: I cannot be held responsible for all social media posts by DMK handles, functionaries: Stalin tells Madras High Court
summary: Denies the charge of having instructed or approved DMK IT Wing’s X post, which reportedly claimed that a narcotic drugs case accused John Britto was Minister Aadhav Arjuna’s relative

title: IIT Bombay student death: Crime Branch scans CCTV footage from exam hall, hostel
summary: According to officials, CCTV cameras inside the examination hall captured Wakode's movements before a professor approached him and led him away from other students after he was allegedly caught copying

title: BJP chief Nitin Nabin reviews organisational activities in western UP ahead of Assembly polls
summary: Nitin Nabin is scheduled to meet former BJP MPs, former legislators and former members of the Legislative Council from western UP to take feedback on the political and electoral situation, former MP Raghav Lakhan Pal Sharma said

title: Pawan Kalyan to shift to Pithapuram by year-end, set up camp office to strengthen Jana Sena
summary: The Deputy Chief Minister admits his absence from the constituency, says elected representatives are less proactive than before and wants the NDA alliance to stay strong without hurting the respect due to his party
